title: Al-Arba'een an-Nawawiyyah: The 40 Hadith of Imam an-Nawawi
description: The forty hadith every student of knowledge must learn - the matn that every Muslim should study: the foundations of Islam, iman and ihsan. Audio explanations for each hadith from Madeenah.com, a Salafi educational library (free distribution with attribution, no material gain).
short_description: The 40 hadith every Muslim should know, with audio explanation

modules.title: The 40 Hadith (Lessons 1-10)
modules.description: The first ten hadith: intention, Jibril, the pillars of Islam, fitrah, innovation, halal/haram, naseehah, sanctity and the heart.
